answer.reason: Both support employer recruiting needs, but Paylocity provides broader HR, payroll, Finance and IT software, while DHI operates specialized talent marketplaces for technology and security-cleared professionals. Recruiting and employer-buyer overlap supports adjacency.
answer.missing_evidence: Passages do not establish equivalent recruiting functionality, matching customer segments, or comparable revenue models.

citations.text: DHI Group, Inc. is a family of purpose-built talent platforms - each built for a specific professional community, not a one-size-fits-all marketplace. DHI Group powers ClearanceJobs and Dice, the platforms top tech talent turn to and employers rely on. Our AI-powered tools and proprietary skills algorithm do the heavy lifting, matching the right candidate to the right opening, fast.

citations.label: C:P1.3
citations.text: Dice is the largest technology-focused talent marketplace in the United States, built over more than 35 years with nearly 8 million technology profiles. Unlike generalized professional networking platforms, Dice organizes talent around more than 100,000 distinct technology skills, allowing recruiters to identify candidates based on the precise capabilities they need.

citations.label: C:P1.4
citations.text: ClearanceJobs is the leading marketplace for professionals with active U.S. security clearances, serving multiple customers, including Lockheed Martin, Booz Allen Hamilton, Leidos, Raytheon, and many others. ClearanceJobs has 2 million cleared candidate profiles, reinforcing our position as the industry's premier destination for cleared technology talent.
